data.title: Circle and Tether freeze $318,000 in USDC and USDT tied to Bitget hack; attacker converts most to ETH before action.
data.description: Two companies issuing stablecoins took action against a wallet named "Bitget Exploiter 8" by blacklisting it, thereby restricting access to approximately $318,000 in USDC and USDT. However, the perpetrator managed to transfer the majority of the funds into Ethereum, which cannot be frozen, before any measures could be taken.

data.title: Bending Spoons successfully syndicates upsized term loan B add-ons
data.description: Milan-based company Bending Spoons has effectively syndicated and priced a $1.25 billion extension to its current US dollar-denominated senior secured term loan B, maturing in 2031, along with a €395 million extension to its existing euro-denominated senior secured term loan B, also maturing in 2031. These amounts surpass the initial targets of $750 million and €250 million. The add-ons, which meet specific conditions, are interchangeable and maintain consistent terms with the original loans.

data.title: Compass’ The Vanderslice Group and The How Group Announce Hard Hat Launch and Demolition Kickoff for New Gateway Luxury Condominium in Ocean City
data.description: In Ocean City, New Jersey, Disston and Harry Vanderslice of The Vanderslice Group at Compass RE, along with The How Group, a developer based in Conshohocken, revealed plans for a new high-end condo project. This development will consist of three stories above a parking area and will be situated at the intersection of 34th Street and Bay Avenue. The official Hard Hat Launch and demolition commencement will occur on September 28, 2026, at 1:00 PM on-site. This event signifies the start of the countdown to demolition at a prominent location in Ocean City.
